subtitle: Elf.Tech Voice Attribution, Live Modular Rig & Synesthetic Archive
scope_note: Constructive creative-engineering, live-rig resilience, and synesthetic archival proposals; zero external cloud inference.

primary_strengths: Pioneering open AI-voice collaboration model (Elf.Tech 50/50 split) and hybrid vocal/synth production.
Rich visual-worldbuilding lore combining music, typography, sigils, and live stage aesthetics.
Expressive single-take hardware/software studio improvisation workflows.
core_bottlenecks: Open-licensed stems lose cryptographic attribution and 50/50 split metadata after transcoding.
Live modular + Ableton + USB-MIDI + DMX rigs risk abrupt dead-air stalls on clock/VST dropouts.
Ephemeral modular patches, MIDI CC chains, and synesthetic scores lack long-term offline preservation.
system_profile.design_north_star: Preserve creative flow state while sealing every vocal stem, live stage clock, and synesthetic cymatic score in zero-cloud, tactile-ready provenance.

improvements.title: Cryptographic Elf.Tech Voice Provenance & 50/50 Consent Licensing Registry
improvements.current_gap: Open-licensed Elf.Tech AI vocal tracks lose creator attribution and 50/50 royalty split metadata once pitch-shifted, remixed, and re-encoded across social platforms.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Emit a dual-layer StemManifest (SHA-256 of dry vocal + instrumental masters, explicit 50/50 split license URI, perceptual chromaprint hash) verifiable 100% offline with executed=False and zero cloud tokens.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses canonical sorted-JSON report_sha256 sealing from fieldglass-causal-chiasm/v1.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: ElfProvenance-v1 StemManifest JSON sidecar + offline chromaprint attribution checker.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Aggressive time-stretching alters simple file hashes. Mitigation: pair exact master SHA-256 with pitch/tempo-tolerant chromaprint signature.
improvements.verification_method: Transcode test stems to 128 kbps MP3 and +/-2 semitone shifts; verify >= 95% attribution match.

improvements.title: Offline-First Stage Visuals & Bar-Quantized Modular Failover (StageChiasm-Sync)
improvements.current_gap: Live electronic sets bridging modular synths, Ableton, USB-MIDI, and DMX stage visuals risk sudden dead-air on a single VST crash or clock jitter spike.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Run an offline-first spectral A_tau(p_t) reactivity engine driving DMX/OSC visuals at 0 cloud latency alongside a bar-quantized shadow clock; when xrun/jitter breaches tau, crossfade seamlessly to the backup stem deck at the next bar boundary.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Applies real-time A_tau(p_t) spectral superlevel volume and causal_chiasm shift alerts.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: StageChiasm-Sync dual-deck watchdog + offline OSC/DMX spectral driver.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +6 ms bar-quantized lookahead and redundant audio bus requirement. Mitigation: auto-engage lookahead only on live performance profile.
improvements.verification_method: Inject synthetic VST hang and USB-MIDI clock dropout mid-bar; verify glitch-free crossfade within 1 bar.

improvements.title: Archival Lore, Score & 2x4 Braille Cymatics Preservation Vault
improvements.current_gap: Visual-music releases, album sigils, and live projection scores exist only as proprietary video/project files, locking out blind/low-vision fans and long-term archival printmakers.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Transform spectral harmonic density (H1, M4^(1/4)) and waveform geometry into framed archival vector SVGs plus 72-column 2x4 Unicode Braille tactile scores paired with lossless stem manifests.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: CymaticBraille-v1 SVG + 2x4 Unicode Braille score generator.

kpis.metric: Tactile score bundle size per track

improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Dense percussion noise clutters tactile dots. Mitigation: filter sub-threshold noise via Bayer 4x4 dithering and harmonic bandpass envelope.
improvements.verification_method: Generate Braille cymatic plates for synthetic harmonic sweeps; assert valid U+2800..U+28FF density between 12% and 65%.

improvements.title: Provenance-Tagged Fan Co-Creation Sandbox (LoreCoCreate-Gate)
improvements.current_gap: Community remixes, AI vocal covers, and visual lore expansions blur canonical studio masters with derivative fan works, causing licensing ambiguity.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Provide a local-first co-creation manifest graph that cryptographically distinguishes canonical_master hashes from community_derivative nodes while preserving attribution chains and explicit remix permissions.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses directed causal provenance edges and non-mutating source-capsule isolation.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: LoreCoCreate-Gate manifest schema + remix lineage verifier.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Friction for casual fan uploads. Mitigation: auto-populate manifest fields from downloaded Elf.Tech stem pack.
improvements.verification_method: Build 3-generation remix tree from canonical master; verify lineage resolver reconstructs full ancestor chain offline.

improvements.title: Single-Take Studio Flow Capture & Immutable Patch DAG (LoreVault-DAG)
improvements.current_gap: Spontaneous single-take vocal/synth sessions, modular patch routings, and MIDI CC automations are lost or overwritten when DAW/OS environments update.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Run a silent background flow-capture daemon that auto-indexes every single-take stem, BPM/key metadata, MIDI CC curve, and synth preset JSON into a content-addressed LoreVault-DAG with instant A/B auditioning.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Inspired by Fieldglass single-take uninterrupted flow-state capture and deterministic SHA-256 cataloging.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: LoreVault-DAG local session indexer + zero-popup flow-capture manifest.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +18 MB lossless delta per session. Mitigation: content-addressed audio chunk deduplication across takes.
improvements.verification_method: Simulate 10 consecutive takes with patch edits; verify zero UI interrupts and 100% A/B state restoration.

telemetry_profile.routing_policy: midi_xrun_stall > tau or chiasm_shift < 0 -> bar-quantized crossfade to shadow stem deck; export -> ElfProvenance-v1 + CymaticBraille
